title: Cyrus and the Gravity Revisited
author: Jude Winterbourne
blurb: Theo Pemberton, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
